description: This PHP class defines an Answer model within the Goteo application's questionnaire module. It manages answer data, including saving, validation, and retrieval of answer lists from the database.

classes.name: Answer
classes.description: Model class representing answers in a questionnaire, with methods for validation, persistence, and complex retrieval.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the answer object; currently always returns true.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the answer object to the database, including optional association with projects.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of answer objects from the database based on provided filters, supporting counting and pagination.
